lines.text: Four men carried their paralyzed friend to Jesus, but the house was so packed they couldn't get near the door.
So they climbed up, tore a hole in someone else's roof, and started lowering him down on his mat.
When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.
He got in because four friends refused to let a crowd decide he couldn't. Whoever you're carrying today, don't stop at the door. In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Word and Faith Network
subtitle: When Jesus Saw Their Faith
story: Four friends carry a paralyzed man through a house too packed to enter, climb onto the roof, tear it open, and lower him down on his mat until he lands at Jesus' feet - and it's their faith, not his, that gets him healed and forgiven in the same breath.
